CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2697 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 3bf97d36aa37989936038feba3c69cc6ae7011c3. Bus nonce: d492d7843a0c5aa6e771840b78ac9206. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 3bf97d36aa37989936038feba3c69cc6ae7011c3`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 3bf97d36aa37989936038feba3c69cc6ae7011c3` or `Fix review: blocked 3bf97d36aa37989936038feba3c69cc6ae7011c3 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: d492d7843a0c5aa6e771840b78ac9206`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `3bf97d36aa37989936038feba3c69cc6ae7011c3` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2697 3bf97d36aa37989936038feba3c69cc6ae7011c3") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2697-d492d784`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Review #2697 (R10-MERGE-SUBJECT-HARDEN, round 11 re-cut: the guard-block cut shared by the harnesses, tools/policy/agreement.mjs unchanged) adversarially, with the finders' harnesses, not the fixer's. Re-derive each figure the body states at this head and report the number you get:

- `node tools/policy/agreement.mjs --self-test` reads SELF-TEST 180 of 180; r10_merge_subject_mutants.py: 86 rows, 0 NOT APPLIED, 2 survivors (Y9, Y10).

- the differential against main: totals 109740 lines, 7445 refused on both sides, 0 main_not_head.

- the new helper's tests/closures.json entries and the INERT/closure classification; the update_pr merge of origin/main reported "LEDGER-MERGE: resolved tests/closures.json", so re-run tests/closure.py or entities.py checks that own that file at this head.
Check that it merges with origin/main. No host or home paths in the diff. Report merge or blocked, with the evidence directory.
